cases.note: The list depends on the form enqueue builds the status from, as the source settles (Q-OF-11, answered 2026-10-29; OF-V5): an initial-lite status, which a run by path after a successful deployment gets in the reference configuration, has a-v, and a full-built one (DISABLE_FLOW_SCRIPT=true at enqueue, OF-V5/b) does not. windmill-lite's reference configuration is the successful lite deployment (0001 §1), so the program always has a-v. The run half, the status ids and the result, is N2's, which implements sleep.
cases.title: lite at enqueue: a-v exists

value:

    - id: a
      sleep: {type: static, value: 1}
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: "export async function main() { return 7 }"
        input_transforms: {}

note: OF-V5/b, the full-built status of DISABLE_FLOW_SCRIPT, is not applicable: windmill-lite always runs the lite form (0001 §1); conformance/openflow/deferred.json says so.
